after.name: Broad head and terminal mouth
after.description: The requested DigitalLife reconstruction preserves the broad flattened head, short transverse mouth and five gill openings on each side. Internal filter screens and coupled mouth/gill pumping are not reconstructed.

after.name: Heterocercal caudal fin
after.description: The source subadult retains an extended upper tail lobe, paired pectoral and pelvic fins, two dorsal fins and anal fin. The creator swimming clip moves the retained skeleton; timing is not a measured physiological rate.

after.name: Spot pattern and longitudinal ridges
after.description: The source body ridges, pale spots and bars and white underside remain. Color response, roughness and restrained fine normal detail are revised. The fine relief suggests skin texture; it is not a microscopic denticle scan or an independently fitted identification pattern.

before.label: Swim · motion study
